It is used in the cooking recipe [[Frog Legs]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Mountain.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|The Mountain - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Abigail, Morgan, Sebastian, Vincent |neutral=Henchman, Lance, Leo, Linus |hate= Clint, Evelyn, George, Haley, Jodi, Kent, Martin, Maru, Olivia, Pam, Pierre, Scarlett, Shane, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Frog}} ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Frog Legs|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|Footer}} ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is required to complete the [[Bundles|Night Fish bundle]]. If Hard bundles are selected, 3 Frogs are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|green}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a green color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:青蛙]]
